caseName: John Doe v. Bd. of Cnty. Commissioners of Payne Cnty.
caseNameFull: John DOE v. BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS OF PAYNE COUNTY, OKLAHOMA

opinions.text: Motion of The Iraq and Afghanistan Veterans of America for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit denied.
